executiveAssessment.text: JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo currently shows AI Consideration of 71.4% and Scenario Presence of 98.4%, with Reality Coverage at 61.5%. Strongest governed signal: Often placed near the top when AI ranks hotels. Primary constraint: Not appearing consistently in AI answers. Versus the prior published run (2026-09-08), material headline movement is AI Consideration +71.4 pp and Scenario Presence +98.4 pp. Independent Positioning shows #1 of 4 with Portfolio AI Presence 71.4%. Independent Positioning is also strong and does not contradict the Core read; benchmark and index remain suppressed while the peer set stays below five hotels. Overall Core performance remains strong; weakness, where present, is concentrated rather than broad. Management should protect demonstrated strengths, review concentrated attribute gaps, and watch competitive displacement where it already appears in evidence.

positiveSignal.title: Positive Signal
positiveSignal.body: Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo appeared in the Top 3 89.6% of the time. This shows how prominently the hotel is positioned when AI includes it.

secondaryCallout.title: Watch Item
secondaryCallout.body: The hotel appeared in at least one AI answer for 98.4% of the traveler needs we tested, but across all individual AI answers it appeared 71.4% of the time. In practical terms, AI recognizes the hotel as relevant for many types of trips, but a traveler will not consistently see it among the hotel options surfaced.

managementPriority.title: Management Priority
managementPriority.body: Confirm the highest-severity reality gaps and review Crowne Plaza Santo Domingo displacement evidence before expanding the action list.

actionAgenda.actionTitle: Stand up a TripAdvisor management-response program with owner, SLA, and theme tracking — focus: designate accountable owner, set response SLA, identify recurring complaint themes monthly
actionAgenda.observedIssue: TripAdvisor appears in 67.2% of cited sources in the current monitoring period (43 citations), making response quality and factual corrections operationally material when misconceptions appear.
actionAgenda.recommendedAction: Confirm the hotel’s canonical facts for TripAdvisor responses with the accountable owner (JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo). Complete the applicable checklist items: designate accountable owner; set response SLA (property-configured; do not invent a default unless governed); identify recurring complaint themes monthly; correct factual misconceptions where appropriate; track response rate. Audit each target source and record current wording/state: TripAdvisor. Correct only the sources where facts are missing, conflicting, or outdated. Do not change measurement methodology. Store completion evidence (canonical policy summary, sources reviewed, sources corrected, URLs/screenshots, completion date). Notify Dealality of completion so the next monitoring period can check the expected signal without assuming causation.
